banner: Real FNMA TBA prices are licensed (Tradeweb, MBS Live, Bloomberg) and have no free feed, so this screen does not invent one. It leads with the mortgage/Treasury spread, which is a LIVE read on whether MBS are rich or cheap, and shows the current-coupon yield DERIVED from the published mortgage rate and the Treasury curve. The coupon stack below is modeled for shape and direction only. Never lock or trade off it.
teaching: The mortgage/Treasury spread is the number to watch here. It is live, and it is what actually tells you whether MBS are cheap or rich.
A wider spread means investors demand more yield to hold mortgages, which pushes your rate up even if the 10-year has not moved.
Current coupon is the yield on the coupon your loans are being pooled into. It tracks the mortgage rate less the primary/secondary spread.
Prices in 32nds are deliberately absent: without a licensed TBA feed, any price here would be a guess dressed up as a quote.
